description: An OmniTool Agent that autonomously performs tasks and makes decisions by leveraging tools like calculators for numerical computations, PDF viewers for document analysis, search engines and web browsers for real-time internet data, and Wikipedia for structured knowledge access—enabling efficient handling of complex queries, research, and data-driven calculations with accurate, contextually relevant results.

tools.name: Calculator
tools.description: A tool for performing numerical computations and mathematical operations, enabling the agent to solve equations and perform calculations efficiently.

tools.name: PDFViewer
tools.description: A tool for analyzing and extracting information from PDF documents, allowing the agent to read and interpret complex documents.

tools.name: SearchEngine
tools.description: A tool for querying the web to retrieve real-time information and data, enabling the agent to access current events and facts.

tools.name: WebBrowser
tools.description: A tool for navigating the internet and accessing web pages, allowing the agent to gather information from various online sources.

tools.name: Wikipedia
tools.description: A tool for accessing structured knowledge and information from Wikipedia, enabling the agent to provide accurate and contextually relevant responses.
